name: BanglaWeatherBench
description: Benchmark definition, evaluation harness, cached forecasts, significance code and figure scripts for BanglaWeatherBench: a benchmark of daily weather forecasting on tropical-monsoon station observations. 16 daily tasks and 170,571 rolling-origin windows over 35 Bangladesh Meteorological Department stations, 10 co-located GHCN-Daily stations, 32 European GHCN-Daily stations as a temperate reference, and NASA POWER reanalysis at all 77 station coordinates, plus an independent CHIRPS dekadal rainfall task. Eight zero-shot time-series foundation models are scored against ten trained and statistical baselines, with resampling by forecast origin, Diebold-Mariano tests and Holm correction across 48 comparisons. Code is released under Apache-2.0. Derived data tracks are rebuilt by the released pipeline. Source data licensing is documented in LICENSING.md: the BMD station record is CC-BY-4.0 (Zubair et al. 2024), GHCN-Daily and NASA POWER are public domain, CHIRPS is open, and Bangladesh administrative boundaries are OCHA/HDX Common Operational Datasets under CC BY-IGO.
